items.exampleEn: She was desperate to see her family again.
items.exampleZh: 她極度渴望再見到家人。

items.exampleEn: She is eager for news from her son abroad.
items.exampleZh: 她迫切想知道在國外的兒子的消息。

items.exampleEn: We had an unexpected visitor last night.
items.exampleZh: 我們昨晚來了一位意外的訪客。

items.exampleEn: The kids sang the song with great enthusiasm.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們充滿熱情地唱著那首歌。

items.exampleEn: It was generous of you to lend me your car.
items.exampleZh: 你借我車，真是太大方了。

items.exampleEn: The shop gives a gift card to reward customer loyalty.
items.exampleZh: 這家店送禮物卡回饋忠實的顧客。

items.exampleEn: Teaching young children takes a lot of patience.
items.exampleZh: 教小孩子需要很大的耐心。

items.exampleEn: Her willingness to help made her popular at work.
items.exampleZh: 她樂於助人，所以在公司很受歡迎。

items.sentenceEn: Thanks for your patience; your food will be ready soon.
items.sentenceZh: 謝謝您耐心等候，您的餐點很快就好。

items.audioEn: I'm eager to start my new job, but I'm a little nervous too.
items.audioZh: 我很期待開始新工作，但也有點緊張。
items.questionZh: 說話者對新工作有什麼感覺？
options: Not interested in the new job at all.

items.sentenceEn: The rain was unexpected, so nobody brought an umbrella.
items.sentenceZh: 這場雨來得很意外，所以沒有人帶傘。

items.sentenceEn: A generous customer left a big tip for the waiter.
items.sentenceZh: 一位大方的客人留了一大筆小費給服務生。

items.stemEn: The team was ____ for a win after losing five games in a row.
items.stemZh: 連輸五場之後，這支隊伍極度渴望贏一場。

items.stemEn: Dogs are famous for their ____ to their owners.
items.stemZh: 狗以對主人忠心而聞名。

items.passageEn: Our small bakery was in trouble last winter. Sales were low, and we were desperate for new ideas. Then something unexpected happened. A generous regular customer offered to share our story online, and her enthusiasm brought in many new faces. Young students were eager to try our bread, and old customers showed their loyalty by coming every day. We thanked everyone for their patience during those busy weeks and for their willingness to wait in long lines.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我們的小麵包店遇到了困難。生意不好，我們急需新點子。後來發生了一件意想不到的事。一位大方的熟客主動在網路上分享我們的故事，她的熱情為我們帶來了許多新面孔。年輕學生迫不及待想嚐嚐我們的麵包，老顧客也每天上門，展現他們的忠誠。我們感謝大家在那幾個忙碌的星期裡耐心等候，也願意排長長的隊伍。

questions.questionZh: 麵包店去年冬天遇到什麼問題？
是什麼讓很多新客人上門？
options: 報紙上的一篇長篇報導
店裡新推出的口味麵包

referenceEn: Thank you very much for your patience.
rubricZh: patience 是不可數名詞「耐心」
「感謝你的⋯」可寫 thank you for your… 等
其他表達感謝的寫法也正確（例如 I appreciate your patience.、Thanks for being so patient.）

items.instructionZh: 用 generous 造一個句子，說說你認識的一位很大方的人。
referenceEn: My grandmother is very generous with her time.
My best friend is generous; she always shares her food.
rubricZh: generous 表示「慷慨的、大方的」，可說 be generous with… 等
寫的是一位你認識的人
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
